Let \(X\) be the set of all \(2 \times 2\) matrices with real entries and \(R \subset X \times X\) be the relation

\[R = \{(A, B) : AB = BA\}.\]

Which of the following statements is true?
options: \(R\) is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive
\(R\) is reflexive and transitive but not symmetric
\(R\) is symmetric and transitive but not reflexive
